name: Mary (female over music bed)
sounds_like: Mid-high female at 219 Hz, mid timbre (centroid 1546 Hz), 6.7 onsets per second over 26.9s - sitting on top of a continuous music bed that never stops under her.
casts_well_as: Only cast this where you actively want a music bed cloned into the output along with the voice.
avoid_for: Clean dialogue of any kind. Any scene that will get its own score later, which in this project is all of them - films/episode01.json lays music under every act.
note: PARTIAL - the voice clones, but it drags the background music with it. Measured proof rather than an assumption from the filename: the energy floor never once drops below -35 dB across 26.9s (silence 0%, longest pause 0.00s), and the pitch tracker latches onto a 59 Hz bassline underneath her, giving a nonsense 28.6-semitone span. The VibeVoice README itself says to avoid the BGM variants unless the bed is wanted. Use en_woman or female_04_maya for clean female narration.
